sum: N. Sujith Kumar Reddy has filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 Regulation 31(4) with the NSE for Rain Industries Limited. The filing constitutes formal notice of a significant shareholding event triggering takeover code obligations.
detail: N. Sujith Kumar Reddy has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure within two working days of crossing the 5% shareholding threshold in a listed company. The disclosure is a mandatory precursor to any open offer or further acquisition under the Takeover Code.
